badge_description: Students demonstrate their ability to operate the 3D printer and complete the printing workflow using Makerspace equipment. This badge recognizes applied skill at the Makerspace facility.
intended_audience: NJIT students enrolled in Makerspace programs
institutional_context: Academic skill development at NJIT Makerspace
earning_criteria_text: Students must demonstrate their 3D printing skills through an in-person practical assessment. A Makerspace instructor observes as the student applies the correct settings, uses the printer software, and executes each step of the workflow. Students must perform all steps independently.
